pages.text: Dragons are your route to the EMC loop. Fire dragons favour $(l)jungles and forests$().$(li)$(l)Cactus Battlesign trick:$() hide behind an unbreakable Cactus Battlesign. Melee and sea-serpent bubble beams are reflected back.

Wear bedrock armor against fire dragons, and spam Shift if one grabs you, to "dismount".$(li)No dragon yet? Raid a $(l)dragon's nest$(). The chests can hold a Botanical Catalyst (1M EMC) and Catalyzing Glands.$(li)To hunt a specific tier, use the scanner or Super Mob Tracker.

$(li)$(l)Infinite fire dragon hearts:$() capture a dragon with a Mob Imprisonment Tool and duplicate it. The copies spawn at random ages, from stage 1 to stage 5. $(l)Never do this near your base.$()$(li)Dragons can wander through Dimensional Doors.
